---
name: Bug / regression
about: A reproducible failure in an existing Kushluk behavior
title: "[Bug] "
assignees: "yigit-denktas"
---

## Traceability (required)
- Type: Bug (set native Issue Type if available)
- Labels: workstream / priority / maturity, from approved repository taxonomy
- Assignee: @yigit-denktas
- Project: Kushluk (after setup issue #62; otherwise pending)
- Project fields: Stage / Priority / Workstream / Maturity / Evidence
- Milestone: verified outcome milestone or TBD
- Parent / related / blocks / blocked by:
- Development branch / pull request: pending until the fix is started

## Reproduction
Exact version, environment, fictional/test data and steps to reproduce.

## Expected and actual behavior
Include a print/edition screenshot only if it does not expose private reading data.

## Impact and risk
Does this affect privacy, copyright entitlements, reliability, physical print, cost, or data loss?

## Acceptance
- [ ] Regression test fails before the fix and passes after
- [ ] Associated PR contains `Closes #N` only when fully resolved
- [ ] Relevant docs, work ledger, master issue #43 and project board reconciled

Never publish credentials, mailbox contents, calendar URLs, or privately subscribed articles.
